body:
Found the real root cause of the founder-flagged 'elos stuck at 1500 again' -- register_generation_snapshot's Elo inheritance always worked, but nothing in rl_train_packet.py ever called record_match_result, so Elo never actually moved off the default. Fixed: rl_train_packet.py now runs one real evaluation match per role per generation (new checkpoint vs. that role's own immediately-prior generation, on a dedicated eval server) and records the real outcome locally and to the remote IDUNA registry. Live-verified on the actual running training process: gen 1 vs gen 0 moved real Elo (1500->1516/1484) for all 3 roles, both locally and on production IDUNA, with zero errors.

⚓ ☃
title: S424: automatic per-generation Elo evaluation fixes 'stuck at 1500'
